meta.title: Device ID Provisioner
meta.description: Write attestation device IDs into the Qualcomm Keymaster trusted app.
meta.warning: This has only been tested on some Qualcomm-based OnePlus devices. Results on other devices are not guaranteed, and a live write changes the IDs the Keymaster TA attests.

form.mainHint: Filled in from this device. Change them only to match the device you are aligning with.
form.advancedHint: IMEI, MEID and the trusted app location.
form.dryRunHint: Build and validate the command without sending it to Keymaster.
form.confirm: Write these IDs into Keymaster now? This cannot be undone from Duck ToolBox.
